body_lead: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM: Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, who has remained silent on allegations relating to the AI camera project, on Saturday said the corruption accusations levelled by Opposition parties were aimed at spoiling the second-anniversary celebrations of his government. Without explicitly referring to the controversy, Pinarayi said the Opposition won’t have its way. “The second anniversary is on and people will learn about the government’s achievements. The Opposition aims to create confusion among people,” he said.
